issue.title: Generated artifact memory drift: sase_artifacts.md goals wording and README token counts
issue.description:
## Memory update

- **Path:** `sase_artifacts.md`

Regenerate via sase memory init: sase_artifacts.md gains goals in the artifact identity list ('Patches, stitches, goals, and indexed files'), README token counts update (1114 to 1116, 20754 to 20756). Observed via sase init memory --check --diff on both dirty and stashed-clean trees in workspace sase_23; unrelated to artifact_link_backfill timeout work.

task_type_fields.proposed_change: Run sase memory init to pick up generator template change adding goals to artifact identity list and refresh README token counts

issue.creation_reason: sase init memory --check reports drift on clean tree; regenerating requires memory authorization, so filing instead of editing.

evidence.note: Proposed by phase sase-1bu.8.2 note #2; reproduced on master 7fc18e6325 with sase init memory --check (exit 1): generated sase_artifacts.md +3/-3 and sase/memory/README.md +2/-2 drift. Same generator output tracked here; no epic-caused code change.

payload.entry: Resolved during sase-1bu.8 landing as remaining G1 epic work: phase sase-1bu.7 changed the goals artifact-memory generator template but omitted regenerated sase/memory/sase_artifacts.md and README.md. sase memory init committed 73eaa9fab0; sase init memory --check now passes. Proposal came from sase-1bu.8.2 note #2.
